scope: Existing CE exact-byte selected lifestyle item assets only; no new art, gameplay, GUI, or translation changes
sourceFreshnessPolicy: Always validate pinned census/input/output closure. With adjacent blockship-plugin or --java-root, additionally reject authority source drift. New runtime census must be passed via --census after definition changes; mismatched IDs/models fail rather than silently reuse an old snapshot.
licensing: Existing selected CE source and generated files contain no bundled food-license notices. Pinned official MIT notices for Croptopia v3 and FarmersDelight are retained as supplementary provenance; locally customized variants are not falsely attributed to those exact upstream revisions. Original pixels and animation bytes are unchanged.

upstreamNotices.scope: Upstream project notice retained as supplementary provenance; not an assertion that all locally customized icons originate from this exact revision
